correctness.rationale: Orbital quotient B_tu=binom(k−t,u)binom(n−2k+t,k−u) computed independently. The binomial-polynomial invariant space has k+1 distinct eigenvalues λ_j=(−1)^j binom(n−k−j,k−j); vertex transitivity gives nonzero P_j e_R, so Krylov powers A^r e_R span the orbital functions and are separated by k counting rounds. First-round classes root/zero intersection/remaining, second-round B_t0=binom(m+t,k) yields iff threshold m>=k−2. Odd quotient when m=1 yields a pathlike alternating BFS order of k+1 strata and exact k−1 rounds. Boundary k=1,2 and matching complement case verified. Independent quotient refinement checked 120 (n,k) pairs and 5 full labeled graphs; finite tests support but do not prove all n,k.
residual_risks: Upper bound k need not be exact for every intermediate density; no graph-identification claim.
